E4Plus1.uk.description: Bart vs. Lisa vs. the Third Grade: Bart and Lisa end up in the same class when Bart's held back a year and Lisa is moved up one. (S14 Ep3/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Hollyoaks
E4Plus1.uk.description: Charlie falls on his sword, but not everyone's ready to forgive and forget. Elsewhere, Misbah plays matchmaker, Frankie wants to do the right thing and Jenson supports Mercedes.

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Marge Gets a Job: When Marge gets a job at the power plant, Mr Burns falls in love with her and invites her over to dinner, complete with a kidnapped Tom Jones to serenade them. (S4 Ep7/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: New: Married at First Sight USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: Four more singles meet their matches at the altar. And it's not the first time some of them have said 'I do'. (S19 Ep2)

E4Plus1.uk.title: New: Celebs Go Dating
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: A very hungover David Potts is grilled at the agency about his passionate date with Anthony. Lucinda Light's choices involve magic and vikings. (S15 Ep12/20)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: On the box this time: Gordon Ramsay's Future Food Stars, Holidaying with Jane McDonald, Open House: The Great Sex Experiment and Peaky Blinders. (S19 Ep8)

Film4.uk.description: (2021) Dystopian crime thriller sequel. The NFFA are back. The Purge is back. Racists feel empowered. And when migrants start to go missing in Texas, it seems like the Purge will never end.

Film4.uk.title: The Story of Robin Hood...
Film4.uk.description: ...and his Merrie Men: (1952) Ken Annakin's telling of Robin Hood's exploits is a cracking, all British affair with Richard Todd, James Robertson Justice, Peter Finch and Joan Rice.

Film4.uk.title: Romancing the Stone
Film4.uk.description: (1984) Comedy action adventure starring Michael Douglas and Kathleen Turner. An adventurer helps a bestselling author to search for her sister, who's been kidnapped in Colombia.

Film4.uk.description: (1985) Helena Bonham Carter stars in this Merchant/Ivory film as an innocent on holiday in Florence, where a meeting with Julian Sands leads to romance.

Film4.uk.title: Horizon Line
Film4.uk.description: (2020) Potential disaster-in-the-skies thriller with Allison Williams and Alexander Dreymon. A couple must fly their small plane to safety when the pilot dies. Easy, right?

Film4.uk.title: Venom
Film4.uk.description: (2018) Dark sci-fi action with Tom Hardy as Marvel's anti-hero. A reporter becomes inhabited by a ferocious extraterrestrial that has its own ideas on how to behave. With Michelle Williams.

Film4.uk.title: Venom: Let There Be Carnage
Film4.uk.description: (2021) Tom Hardy returns as Marvel's gnarly antihero, to face a symbiote spawned from Venom's own blood living inside a serial killer who looks just like Woody Harrelson. Yikes.

Film4.uk.title: Millie Lies Low
Film4.uk.description: (2021) Comedy drama with Ana Scotney. A woman leaves her native New Zealand to take up an internship at a top New York architecture firm. Except she doesn't, but then pretends she still is.

Film4.uk.description: (1961) Western starring John Wayne and Stuart Whitman. A Texas Ranger is forced to team up with his prisoner while he's on a covert mission to take on a band of thieves and gunrunners.

Film4.uk.title: Fixed Bayonets!
Film4.uk.description: (1951) Korean War drama about the stress of battle. Officers drop one by one as a US platoon fights a rearguard action, leaving one unwilling man (Richard Basehart) to take their place.

Film4.uk.description: (1956) Lauren Bacall, Robert Stack, Rock Hudson and Dorothy Malone star in Douglas Sirk's drama, a commentary on 1950s life that's disguised as a lurid, glossy soap opera.

Film4.uk.title: Criss Cross
Film4.uk.description: (1949) Muscular film noir starring Burt Lancaster and Yvonne De Carlo. A dame convinces her ex-husband, an armoured car guard, to come in on a daring robbery.

Film4.uk.title: Fisherman's Friends
Film4.uk.description: (2019) Heart-warming comedy based on the real-life story of the Cornish folk ensemble who took the UK charts by storm in 2010, starring Daniel Mays and Tuppence Middleton.

Film4.uk.title: Angel Has Fallen
Film4.uk.description: (2019) Action-thriller sequel. Secret agent Mike Banning (Gerard Butler) goes on the run when he's framed for an attack on the President. Can he clear his name?

Film4.uk.title: Three Thousand Years of Longing
Film4.uk.description: (2022) Fantasy with Idris Elba and Tilda Swinton. A djinn offers a storytelling expert three wishes. But she knows to look this gift horse in the mouth and so makes it all about him.

Film4.uk.description: (2023) Rapper Baloji's debut is a mythic familial psychodrama about a young man who takes his pregnant fiancée to the Democratic Republic of Congo to meet the parents. In French/subs.

Film4.uk.title: Miss Peregrine's Home for...
